summary: Frontend regression test of FASE 2 hooks refactor (useGlobalContext, useGeneratedPlans, useSportsCatalog, useTournaments) on Modo Clásico and Modo Pro. Login with test@train.com / test123456 → dashboard renders Readiness, ACWR ratio, charts (Volumen/Intensidad/Densidad, Intensidad y Recuperación, Distribución de Fases, Carga Acumulada) correctly. ZERO console errors / warnings on the dashboard. Modo Clásico ↔ Modo Pro toggle works flawlessly (verified Modo Pro sidebar layout renders w/o crash and same Panel content). Datos tab navigates to empty-state ('Selecciona un Plan' / 'Ver mis planes' / 'Crear Nuevo Plan'), which is the expected empty render of renderDataContent() when no active plan is selected — Deportes/Torneos sub-tabs of Información live inside the plan-active layout and require a selected plan to inspect, so they were not directly reachable from this account state. Hooks fetch on mount (sportsCatalog GET /api/sports/catalog, tournaments GET /api/tournaments) and produced no console errors, indicating the API wiring of useSportsCatalog and useTournaments is healthy. HOWEVER, a CRITICAL regression was found: the new useGlobalContext hook collides with the existing GlobalContextProvider on the SAME localStorage key 'train_global_context' but uses an INCOMPATIBLE schema, breaking persistence/filter logic of both modules.

integration_issues.flow: Top-bar global context filters (Entidad/Equipo/Atleta/Deporte) — Modo Clásico & Pro
integration_issues.issue: localStorage key COLLISION: /app/frontend/src/hooks/useGlobalContext.js (the new FASE 2 hook) writes {entityId, teamId, athleteId, sportId} (string IDs / 'all') to the SAME key 'train_global_context' that /app/frontend/src/context/GlobalContext.js writes {selectedEntity, selectedTeam, selectedAthlete, selectedSport} (full objects). Verified at runtime — after fresh login, localStorage.getItem('train_global_context') returns {"selectedEntity":null,"selectedTeam":null,"selectedAthlete":null,"selectedSport":null} (i.e. the Context provider wrote last). When DashboardPage's new hook reads this saved value, it returns it directly as globalContext, so globalContext.entityId is undefined (NOT 'all'). Consequence: filteredTeams = teams.filter(t => t.federation === undefined || t.club === undefined) → empty list; filteredAthletes filter against entityId !== 'all' (undefined !== 'all' is true) → also empty unless athlete has no federation/club fields. Both modules also race-overwrite each other on every selection. This is a real regression of the refactor — the previous monolithic code presumably did not collide with GlobalContextProvider.

action_items: HIGH PRIORITY — Fix the localStorage key collision in /app/frontend/src/hooks/useGlobalContext.js. Recommended: change STORAGE_KEY to a hook-specific name (e.g. 'train_dashboard_filters' or 'train_topbar_context') so it does not stomp on or get stomped by /app/frontend/src/context/GlobalContext.js. Alternatively, harden the initializer: if the parsed object does not contain the expected keys (entityId/teamId/athleteId/sportId), fall back to the defaults instead of returning the parsed object as-is.

After the rename, manually verify (a) selecting a value in the top-bar persists across a reload and (b) the existing GlobalContextProvider selections (sidebar/global filters that use Context) still survive reload — both currently overwrite each other.

OPTIONAL: provide an active-plan test account (or seed one) so that the Datos → Información → Deportes / Torneos sub-tabs can be reached in regression UI tests. Currently the test coach 'test@train.com' lands on the empty 'Selecciona un Plan' state, which prevents end-to-end verification of those sub-sections from a fresh login.
critical_code_review_comments: hooks/useGlobalContext.js:11 — uses the SAME localStorage key 'train_global_context' as context/GlobalContext.js:6. Rename one of them; this is the root cause of the regression and a 5-second fix.

hooks/useGlobalContext.js:10-18 — the initializer does no schema validation. JSON.parse(...) of a foreign-shape blob is returned verbatim. Add a shape guard: `if (parsed && typeof parsed.entityId === 'string') return parsed;` else return defaults.

hooks/useSportsCatalog.js:4-6 — hard-coded fallback to window.location.origin and an inline filter for 'itrain.com' is fragile. Should rely on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exclusively (per repo conventions). Same shape repeated across the codebase — extract into one src/lib/apiBase.js.

hooks/useGeneratedPlans.js:18-28 — saveGeneratedPlan uses Date.now().toString() as id, which collides if a user generates two plans within the same millisecond (rare but real). Use crypto.randomUUID() if available.

DashboardPage.js is still 4591 lines after FASE 2. The 4 hooks extracted ~200 lines; consider continuing extraction (CoachAI drawer state, plan-data state machine, evaluation forms) before this file becomes unmaintainable.

success_rate.frontend: 5/7 user flows verified (login, dashboard render, classic mode, mode toggle, no console errors). Datos→Información→Deportes & →Torneos sub-tabs not reachable without an active plan from the supplied test account. 1 critical regression found (global context key collision).

context_for_next_testing_agent: To fully verify Deportes/Torneos UI you need a coach with at least one active plan selected. Either seed a plan for test@train.com or use a fresh account and run the 'Crear Nuevo Plan' flow via Coach AI first; then renderDataContent() shows the 'Información' tab with the Deportes catalog and Torneos sub-section. Hooks load on mount, so console-error absence on dashboard is partial evidence the sports-catalog and tournaments fetches succeed. The localStorage collision is reproducible: open DevTools after login, run localStorage.getItem('train_global_context') — you will see {selectedEntity:...} (Context shape), NOT {entityId:'all',...} (hook shape). After main agent renames the hook's STORAGE_KEY, re-run this verification.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: the new hook /app/frontend/src/hooks/useGlobalContext.js was given the SAME localStorage key 'train_global_context' that the pre-existing GlobalContextProvider in /app/frontend/src/context/GlobalContext.js already owns, but with a different schema. Reproduction: 1) Fresh login as test@train.com. 2) Open DevTools → Application → Local Storage → 'train_global_context'. Observe shape {selectedEntity, selectedTeam, selectedAthlete, selectedSport} (provider wrote last). 3) In DashboardPage, globalContext.entityId is undefined → filteredTeams/filteredAthletes calculations break and the top-bar Selects will appear inconsistent. Mitigation (1-line fix in the hook): change localStorage.getItem/setItem key from 'train_global_context' to e.g. 'train_dashboard_filters', AND/OR add a shape guard in the useState initializer so that an unrecognized blob falls back to the defaults. Also recommended: add an integration test that mounts both providers and asserts neither overwrites the other's persistence.
